copy.toast.touch-spent.after: Already assessed: no points. Find a fresh car.
copy.toast.touch-spent.why: T15: verdict, then the fix; was three sentences (F6)

copy.toast.purchase.after: {node} will be installed on the next chassis.
copy.toast.purchase.why: kept: T16 status, crisp and correct

copy.toast.learn-standoff.after: {model} revised its stop line to {metres} m.
copy.toast.learn-standoff.why: kept: T16 status; flat log of the fleet learning

copy.toast.refusal-locked.after: Premature. Complete one body before refusing.

copy.denied.lunge.after: Impatient. Wait for charge and recovery, then dash.
copy.denied.lunge.why: T15: put-down, then the fix; the move is the dash (A)

copy.denied.pickup.after: Nothing in reach. Stand by a cone, then grab (X).
copy.denied.pickup.why: T15: adds the fix; names grab (X)

copy.denied.drop.after: No legal room. Face open ground to set the cone down.

copy.denied.throw.after: Cone retained. Face open road, then throw (Y).
copy.denied.throw.why: T15: verdict, then the fix; names throw (Y)

copy.endings.Non-compliant.after: Testing declined. Your refusal has been recorded.

copy.shop.bank.after: Keep {credits} in credit. Deploy next chassis

place.levels.z1.after: Low highway: own cars only. Broken parapets drop you down.

place.levels.z2Highway.after: High highway: fast cars. A broken parapet is a long fall.

place.levels.roof.after: Roof: no traffic. Step off a ledge to reach the street.
place.levels.roof.why: fits 60 characters; varies a repeated phrase (T14)

msg.held.after: Try harder. Held at {health}; last hit: {brief}.
msg.held.why: T15: Lawrence's put-down, then the brief as the fix

msg.story-miss.task.why: T15: put-down, then the fix in the imperative

msg.story-miss.cleared.after: NOT COUNTED · Redundant. {tile} is cleared; move on.

msg.story-miss.elsewhere.after: NOT COUNTED · Off site: {tile} is not in test. Check the map.

msg.fence.unsurveyed.after: Ambitious. {tile} is unsurveyed; clear the tile in test.
msg.fence.unsurveyed.why: T15: dry put-down, then the fix

msg.fence.clear-first.why: T15: procedural put-down, then the fix

msg.hop.after: Hops clear nothing. Run, then jump.
msg.hop.why: T15: put-down cut to three words; same joke

msg.hitch.after: Hitched. X lets go; A slings you off with a dash.
msg.hitch.why: kept: teaches the controls accurately (X, A)

msg.slip.after: No traction. Step off the puddle to dash.
msg.slip.why: T15: short verdict, then the fix

msg.not-fitted.after: Not fitted yet. Keep clearing; a drone will deliver it.
msg.not-fitted.why: T15: adds the fix; drone delivers parts by tile

msg.deny.jump.after: Grounded. Wait for charge, or finish the move.

msg.deny.jump.charge.after: Battery flat. Let it recharge, then jump.
msg.deny.jump.charge.why: T15: verdict, then the fix; the battery refills

msg.deny.push.spent.after: Overdrawn. Land to get your pushes back.
msg.deny.push.spent.why: T15: corporate put-down, then the fix

msg.deny.push.nothing.after: Pushing air. Hit or touch a car first.

msg.deny.drop.hold.after: Hold X to put the cone down
msg.deny.drop.hold.why: kept: teaches the control accurately (hold X)

msg.deny.throw.empty.after: Empty-handed. Grab a cone (X), then throw (Y).
msg.deny.throw.empty.why: T15: put-down, then the fix; controls kept

msg.purchase-denied.max.after: Already top rank. Upgrade a different part.
msg.purchase-denied.max.why: V1: drops 'level'; T15 verdict, then the fix

msg.level.walk.after: Walkway: no traffic. Step off the side onto the cars below.

msg.level.ring.after: Ring deck: cars yield at the entries. Escalators go down.

msg.level.terrace.after: Terrace: step off the edge to drop to the beach.
msg.level.terrace.why: kept: plain hint, fits the strip

msg.level.hill.after: Hilltop: live traffic. Step off the cliff to the valley.
msg.level.hill.why: fits 60 characters; drops the Z1 code

obj.task.after: Write off a body. Last hit: {brief} ({n} of {need}).
obj.task.why: kept: the strip's brief, imperative and clear

obj.any.why: kept: the strip's brief, imperative and clear

obj.drone.voyage.after: Carrying you, Certified, to the ship at {tile}.
obj.drone.voyage.why: canon: Certified takes a capital C; addresses you (T5)

obj.arcade.after: Grade {g}: write off {n} bodies for grade {next} ({count} of {n}).

obj.arcade.top.after: Grade {g}, the top grade: write off all you can.

rep.counted.why: T16: praise withheld; varies a repeated phrase (T14)

rep.task.after: Wrong finish, {points} points, not counted. Next body's last hit: {brief}.

rep.cleared.after: Surplus: {tile} was already cleared, so not counted ({points} points). Advance.

rep.elsewhere.after: Wrong tile: {tile} is not in test, so not counted ({points} points). Consult the map.

rep.credit.after: +{n} credits for the body; balance {balance}. {part} is yours for {price}.

rep.full.after: +{n} credits for the body; balance {balance}. Every track is full.

shop.keep.after: Keep {n} upgrades for later, or fit them now.

shop.top.why: V1: 'level' is banned; rank is canon (F7)

map.unsurveyed.after: Clear the tiles before it. The map opens one tile at a time.

map.fences.after: Fenced until cleared. Cleared tiles stay open.

map.need.after: One counted write-off clears the tile.

map.needN.after: {n} counted write-offs clear the tile ({count} so far).

card.sub.why: V1: 'level' is banned; tiles are in test

pause.story.after: The story map saves this tile's count. The chassis in service is lost.

pause.refuse-locked.after: Refusal opens after one completed body.

end.certified.fallback.why: canon: the ending is CERTIFIED; capital C

scores.none.arcade.after: Nothing on file. Work a shift in {district}.
scores.none.arcade.why: V1: drops 'scores'; T15 put-down, then the fix

scores.none.story.after: Position vacant. Become Certified to fill it.
scores.none.story.why: V1: drops 'scores'; dry put-down, then the fix

saves.rename.after: Type to replace the name, or OK to keep it.
